name: Italian Chicken Sandwich
steps: Slice two slices of sourdough bread and toast them until golden brown.

Spice the chicken breast with salt, pepper, garlic, paprika and Italian seasoning. Cook the chicken breast in a pan until fully cooked and golden brown on both sides. You can also air fry at 200°C for 15 minutes or until fully cooked, or bake in the oven at 200°C for 20 minutes.
Slice the cooked chicken breast into thin slices.
Slice the romaine lettuce, red onion, jalapeno, and sundried tomato into thin slices.
Chopp the mozzarella and gouda cheese into small pieces.
In a small bowl, mix together the chicken, vegetables, and cheese. Add a drizzle of dijon mustard and red wine vinegar to the mixture and toss until everything is evenly coated.
Assemble the sandwich by placing the chicken mixture on one slice of toasted sourdough bread, and then top it with the other slice of bread.
